messages:
Rae (Design): quick sync on the compact metrics pill idea. goal: a thin bar above the heatmap showing p95 + rps + error rate in a single-line pill to save vertical space. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/compact-pill.png

Jon (Frontend): neat. question: per-route or global pill? for route lists we'd want per-row, but overview should be a single global pill.

Priya (PM): agree. priority: make p95 stand out. overview = global pill with route-group selector.

Luis (Eng-Infra): perf note: many live sparklines are heavy. propose server-side micro-tiles or shared canvas rendering, and lazy-load extras.

Zoe (a11y): accessibility: ensure keyboard focus, clear focus ring, and descriptive aria-labels for sparklines. contrast on error chip is too low.

Rae (Design): i'll bump red saturation and make p95 visually larger than p50. considering collapsed label "p95 230ms" for quick scanning.

Jon (Frontend): collapsed explicit value is useful. expansion via chevron should animate but respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Priya (PM): sampling control needed. default = auto-sample. toggle to raw with a confirmation for large time ranges. copy suggestion: "Auto-sample: smooths noise and keeps UI responsive. Toggle to view raw data (higher cost)."

Luis (Eng-Infra): backend support: sampled series by default, raw fetch on demand with a cost-estimate endpoint and per-account quota. will add feature flag.

Zoe (a11y): sampling toggle must announce state changes (aria-live) and include long description of tradeoffs. touch target sizes must be >=48px on mobile.

Rae (Design): noted. i'll increase touch targets and add an error icon inside the chip (not color-only). tooltip will contain expanded definitions and keyboard hint 'Press "m" to toggle metrics'.

Jon (Frontend): dev checklist: CSS for compact pill, collapse/expand, aria-live region, sampling toggle with aria-pressed, shortcut 'm' to focus pill, analytics events (throttled). estimate 2 sprints plus infra work.

Luis (Eng-Infra): infra checklist: microtiles, cost-estimate endpoint, quota signals, feature flags, server-side throttles.

Zoe (a11y): i'll draft a short a11y checklist: focus order, aria-pressed, aria-live throttling, contrast, touch targets, reduced-motion. will test keyboard-only once prototype is up.

Priya (PM): QA acceptance criteria: 1) p95 is visually prioritized; 2) collapsed pill shows latest p95 value; 3) sampling defaults to auto and raw fetch requires explicit action and confirmation; 4) keyboard accessible and aria announcements present.

Rae (Design): i'll upload updated assets and a Loom with the pill interactions later today.

ci-bot: Build queued for branch/compact-pill-proto  build#4892 started.

Priya (PM): thanks all. we'll review next Wed after assets and PRs are up.
